name: Brimstone Heart
body:
School transmutation [evil]; Level antipaladin 3, cleric/oracle 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like lesser brimstone heart, except you gain low-light vision, darkvision 60, resistance to cold and fire 10, and DR 5/good, and you sprout dark, leathery wings allowing you to fly at a speed of 30 feet with average maneuverability. In addition, your natural weapons and any weapons you wield are considered evil-aligned for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.
